slides: You never make it because you refuse the small door
You are stuck behind what I call the pride wall
If you turned down the role because it felt too small
if you skipped the step because someone might see you start at the bottom
if you told yourself you deserve better before you proved anything
Pride is the most expensive hobby a broke man can have
Walk through the small door Follow for the rules nobody taught you
caption:
Discipline, mindset, and self improvement for men all have one enemy: the ego that says starting small is beneath you.

Most men wait for the big title. The man who wins takes any job that keeps him near the room and proves himself from inside.

Your pride is costing you the thing you want most.

The small door is not a step down. It is the only door that actually opens.

Take it before someone less talented but more humble walks through it first.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
